stem.en: A school club spends ₹450 on bread, butter and chutney to make 50 sandwiches. At lunch it sells all 50 sandwiches at ₹12 each. How much profit, in rupees, did the club make?

hints.en: First find the money collected: 50 sandwiches at ₹12 each.
Then take away the ₹450 spent on the sandwiches.
